messages:
Priya: Noticing an odd spike in per-tenant quota consumption for route /v1/chat/stream — console shows ~3x normal for a 10m window but raw ingress events don't match. Anyone on routing team?
Darnell: Which tenants? any recent routing changes or header normalization PRs?
Priya: Affected tenants: tb-9a1, tb-3c4. Change we rolled yesterday was header-normalize v2 (strip `x-client-sampling`). Deployed 03:12 UTC.
Zoe: Wait, strip x-client-sampling? that header used to indicate downstream sampling flags. If we dropped it, proxy might be treating sampled requests as full-charge. Did we change attribution logic?
Miguel: I saw the PR. It removed passthrough of `x-client-sampling` to avoid leaking dups to backend. But we kept `quota.approximate = true` logic in proxy which uses that header when present. If header disappears, proxy flips to exact-accounting and emits per-token events for all requests.
Priya: Ugh. So removing the header caused proxy to stop applying the sampling multiplier and count every sampled request as 1. That matches the 3x bump.
Darnell: Can we detect which events are impacted? quota-bot?
quota-bot: quota-bot: Found 4,712 requests from proxies without x-client-sampling header for tenants [tb-9a1,tb-3c4] between 03:12-03:22 UTC flagged as `sampling_mismatch=true`.
Zoe: We need a quick mitigation: re-add header passthrough to proxies OR adjust downstream aggregator to fall back to the legacy sampling multiplier if header missing AND ingress included `x-proxy-sampled: true`. Which is safer?
Miguel: Short term re-add passthrough in proxy (rollback the header-strip) — fastest. Longer term make aggregation robust: store `sampling_rate` into event metadata during tokenization so downstream doesn't rely on presence of optional headers.
Priya: Customer impact: billing preview shows inflated tokens for that 10m window. We should avoid generating invoices with the spike. Operational plan: rollback proxy header change in prod (5min), then run a reconciliation job to recompute aggregates for the window and mark invoices as "recomputed" where necessary. Also emit a `billing_adjustment` event if invoices were already materialized.
Darnell: Agree. Also add metric `sampling_mismatch_count` and an alert if >1000 mismatches/min for any region.
Zoe: One subtlety: some Dedicated customers intentionally strip sampling headers for privacy; we must respect per-tenant config. So the rollback must be gated by tenant opt-in. We'll need to check feature flags.
Priya: I added a quick canary rollback to staging then 10% prod. Pushed PR #8321 with revert for header-strip and a toggle. Will monitor.
Miguel: For reconciliation, I'll write a small job that replays raw request records and reapplies sampling multiplier if `x-client-sampling` present in original raw_log. If header completely missing but proxy had `x-proxy-sampled=true`, use tenant default sampling rate.
Priya: Action items: Darnell (approve rollback PR), Miguel (recon job + tests), Zoe (update per-tenant sampling flag UI + docs), I'll notify CS about possible preview/invoice noise.
quota-bot: quota-bot: Created ticket Q-2026: "sampling header strip caused quota spike" and attached sample traces.
